strings.legal.terms.title: Terms
strings.legal.terms.intro: These terms cover your use of Clout City: NYC, a game set in a shared, live version of New York City.
strings.legal.terms.age: Clout City: NYC is for players 18 and over. If you are under 18, you may not play.
strings.legal.terms.conduct: Treat other players with respect. Play fair and keep it friendly. Our {conduct} explains what's allowed in the shared city.
strings.legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
strings.legal.privacy.intro: This policy explains what Clout City: NYC keeps about you.
strings.legal.privacy.stored: On this device we store that you confirmed you are 18 or over and when, the version of the Terms and Privacy Policy you agreed to and when, and your sound choice.
strings.legal.privacy.birthYear: We never store, log or send the year you were born. It is used only to check your age on the welcome card.
strings.legal.conduct.title: Code of Conduct
strings.legal.conduct.intro: Clout City: NYC is a shared city. Everyone in it is a real person trying to make it, same as you. These rules keep it fun for everyone.
strings.legal.conduct.adults.heading: Adults only
strings.legal.conduct.adults.body: The shared city is for players 18 and over. If you're under 18, you can't play.
strings.legal.conduct.respect.heading: Respect other players
strings.legal.conduct.respect.body: Talk trash about the rent, not about people. Treat everyone the way you'd want to be treated on your own block.
strings.legal.conduct.notAllowed.heading: Not allowed
strings.legal.conduct.notAllowed.harassment: Harassment, bullying, threats or following someone around to bother them.
strings.legal.conduct.notAllowed.hate: Hate speech, slurs, or attacking anyone for who they are.
strings.legal.conduct.notAllowed.sexual: Sexual content of any kind, in handles, chat or anywhere else.
strings.legal.conduct.notAllowed.personal: Sharing anyone's personal info: real names, addresses, phone numbers, emails or social accounts. Yours included.
strings.legal.conduct.notAllowed.scams: Scams, spam, or trying to get anything from another player outside the game.
strings.legal.conduct.notAllowed.impersonation: Pretending to be someone else, including staff or a moderator.
strings.legal.conduct.notAllowed.cheating: Cheating: hacking, tampering with saves, bots, or exploiting bugs.
strings.legal.conduct.tools.heading: Block, mute and report
strings.legal.conduct.tools.block: Block: you and that player stop seeing each other anywhere in the city. It also ends your friendship and any roommate link. They aren't told.
strings.legal.conduct.tools.mute: Mute: their avatar and emotes are hidden for you. Nothing changes for them.
strings.legal.conduct.tools.report: Report: tell our moderators what happened. Pick a reason and add a short note if you want. The player isn't told who reported them.
strings.legal.conduct.tools.where: You'll find these on every player, and your blocked and muted lists under Me.
strings.legal.conduct.sanctions.heading: What happens when someone breaks the rules
strings.legal.conduct.sanctions.body: A moderator reviews every report. Depending on what happened, they can dismiss it, give a warning, reset a handle, limit an account (no friends, chat or emotes), suspend it for a while, or ban it from the shared city.
strings.legal.conduct.sanctions.hidden: Handles reported by several players can be hidden until a moderator looks at them.
strings.legal.conduct.appeals.heading: Appeals
strings.legal.conduct.appeals.body: If a moderator acts on your account, you'll see a message with the reason the next time you play. You can appeal a warning, a limit, a suspension or a ban once, from that message.
strings.legal.conduct.crisis.heading: If someone might get hurt
strings.legal.conduct.crisis.body: Reports aren't watched in real time. If you or someone else is in danger, don't wait for us.
strings.legal.conduct.crisis.988: Call or text 988 for the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline (US).
strings.legal.conduct.crisis.911: Call 911 if someone is in immediate danger.
strings.legal.conduct.crisis.outsideUs: Outside the US, call your local emergency number.
